# Example results (generated by examples/run_examples.sh)

Each example image (128x128, synthetic PGM) was processed with
global histogram equalization (`he`) and with CLAHE
(`clahe --tiles 8x8 --clip 2.0`). Statistics below are the real
output of `ihe compare` on the generated files.

## gradient

```
examples/gradient.pgm (128x128, 16384 px)
  mean    : 127.01
  stddev  : 73.91
  min/max : 0 / 255
  entropy : 7.00 bits
examples/outputs/gradient_he.pgm (128x128, 16384 px)
  mean    : 127.50
  stddev  : 74.33
  min/max : 0 / 255
  entropy : 7.00 bits
MSE  : 0.49
PSNR : 51.21 dB
```

```
examples/gradient.pgm (128x128, 16384 px)
  mean    : 127.01
  stddev  : 73.91
  min/max : 0 / 255
  entropy : 7.00 bits
examples/outputs/gradient_clahe.pgm (128x128, 16384 px)
  mean    : 141.59
  stddev  : 72.80
  min/max : 0 / 255
  entropy : 6.84 bits
MSE  : 239.37
PSNR : 24.34 dB
```
